Matthew Jacoby

Bio

Matthew is a current student at Johns Hopkins University’s Bloomberg School of Public Health studying in the Molecular Microbiology and Immunology department. His previous work and interests span Quantum Mechanical simulations, Molecular Dynamics simualtions, identifying Host/Pathogen interactions, structural/molecular/and microbiology. When not working, he is an active participant in two choirs: The New Wave Singers of Baltimore & Mosaic Community Chorus, bakes when he has free time, and enjoys watching movies and TV shows.
